subject: Thank you for applying to Stripe - Staff Distributed Systems Engineer
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for your interest in joining Stripe as a Staff Distributed Systems Engineer. We wanted to confirm that we've received your application and resume.

Our recruiting team is actively reviewing your background against the role requirements. Because we review each profile with care, this typically takes 3-5 business days. You can monitor your application status anytime via the Stripe candidate portal.

Best regards,
Stripe Talent Acquisition Team

subject: URGENT JOB OFFER: Senior Cloud Architect at Google Cloud ($240,000/yr)
body:
Dear Candidate,

Congratulations! Based on your LinkedIn profile, Google Cloud hiring committee has selected you for the direct-hire role of Senior Cloud Architect.

Compensation package: $240,000 base salary + equity bonus. No formal interview required due to immediate enterprise project expansion.

To courier your pre-configured Apple M3 Max MacBook workstation and security clearance token, kindly wire a refundable asset security deposit of $650 (or ₹54,000) to our designated vendor UPI ID: googlecorp-equipment@okaxis or via wire transfer within 24 hours. The full amount will be reimbursed on your first paycheck.

Warm regards,
Robert Vance
Executive Talent Partner, Google HR Operations (Global)

subject: Invitation to Technical Architecture Interview - DataDog (Senior Backend Platform)
body:
Hi Alex,

We were very impressed by your background and your open-source contributions. The team would love to move forward with a 60-minute technical architecture conversation.

You will meet with Sarah Chen (Principal Engineer) to dive into distributed caching, consensus models, and observability pipeline scaling. Please select a time slot that suits you best using this Calendly link: https://calendly.com/datadog-talent/alex-technical-loop

Looking forward to speaking soon!

Best,
Marcus Wright | Technical Recruiting Lead, DataDog

subject: Application Received: Senior Full Stack Engineer at Figma
body:
Hello Alex,

Thank you for submitting your application for the Senior Full Stack Engineer position at Figma.

We have received your materials and our hiring team is reviewing them. Due to the high volume of applications, we will reach out if there is a strong mutual fit for this or other opportunities.

Thank you for your time and continued interest in Figma.

Sincerely,
The Figma Recruiting Team

subject: Amazon AWS Remote Software Engineer - Mandatory Onboarding & Background Verification Fee
body:
Dear Applicant,

Your application for Amazon AWS Remote Software Development Engineer (L6) has passed the preliminary screening with flying colors.

Before we issue your official Offer Letter and tax documents, Amazon Corporate Compliance requires all global remote hires to complete an expedited biometric screening and credential background audit. 

Please remit the mandatory state screening fee of $280 / ₹23,000 via PayPal or wire transfer directly to our compliance verification agency partner: verify-amazon-portal@yahoo.com.

Failure to remit within 48 hours will result in automatic forfeiture of the position.

Sincerely,
Amazon Worldwide Talent Acquisition Operations

subject: Update regarding your application to Vercel (Staff Frontend Architect)
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for investing your time in interviewing with Vercel and completing our technical evaluation. We truly appreciate the opportunity to learn more about your technical philosophy and your impressive work.

While our team was deeply impressed with your depth in web performance and Next.js internal architecture, we have chosen to move forward with another candidate whose experience slightly closer aligns with our immediate infrastructure roadmap.

We would love to stay in touch for future leadership openings as our core framework team expands.

Warm regards,
Elena Rostova | Head of Engineering Recruiting, Vercel

subject: Formal Offer of Employment: Anthropic - Member of Technical Staff (Inference Systems)
body:
Dear Alex,

On behalf of Anthropic, PBC, I am thrilled to extend an official offer of employment for the position of Member of Technical Staff, Inference Systems, reporting to Dario Amodei's organization.

Key Terms of Offer:
- Base Annual Salary: $265,000 USD
- Equity Grant: 18,000 Incentive Stock Units (4-year vesting schedule)
- Relocation & Home Office Stipend: $15,000
- Target Start Date: November 16, 2026

Please review and execute the attached formal offer letter and benefits agreement via DocuSign by October 28, 2026.

Welcome to Anthropic!

Best,
Jessica Miller | VP of People, Anthropic

subject: We've received your application for Lead Infrastructure Engineer at Airbnb
body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for applying for the Lead Infrastructure Engineer position at Airbnb! We know looking for a new role takes energy, and we appreciate your time and enthusiasm.

Our team is reviewing your profile and will update you as soon as possible. In the meantime, you can check out our tech blog at medium.com/airbnb-engineering to see what our team is building.

Warmly,
Airbnb Talent Experience

subject: IMMEDIATE HIRE: AI Data Annotation Specialist ($95/hr) - Submit Identity & Bank Passbook
body:
Congratulations Alex,

Our executive hiring panel evaluated your public profile and you have been hired on the spot for our VIP AI Data Annotation project. Salary is $95/hour paid weekly directly to your bank account.

To enroll you in our automated international payroll system immediately without tax withholding, please reply to this message attaching unredacted front/back scans of your Passport or National ID card, Social Security Number / PAN card, along with your online banking login portal screenshot or voided cheque.

We look forward to having you start tomorrow morning at 9:00 AM EST.

Regards,
David Sterling | Global Recruitment Director

subject: Linear Engineering: Invitation to System Design Round (Alex x Karri)
body:
Hey Alex,

Loved your take on offline-first sync engines and state reconciliation during the initial screen with Tuomas. We would love to schedule the next stage: System Design & Product Craft.

You'll spend 75 minutes with Karri Saarinen (Co-Founder) and our Core Sync Team. We prioritize collaborative problem solving over algorithmic trivia. Let us know your availability across Tuesday and Wednesday next week.

Best,
Camilla | People Operations at Linear

subject: Application Received: Netflix Senior Distributed Data Systems Engineer
body:
Hello Alex,

Thank you for your application to Netflix. Our culture values freedom and responsibility, and we take deliberate care in reviewing candidates who can thrive in this environment.

Your application has been logged in our system. If your skillset aligns with the team's needs for this quarter, a member of our talent team will reach out directly.

Best,
Netflix Talent Discovery

subject: Meta AI Engineering Assessment - $150 Registration & Sandbox Access Fee Required
body:
Dear Candidate,

You have been shortlisted for the Meta L7 Principal AI Research Engineer position at our Menlo Park campus.

Before accessing the proprietary Meta Coding Sandbox and taking the mandatory AI benchmark assessment, candidates must remit a refundable platform licensing registration fee of $150 (₹12,500) via Bitcoin wallet or Zelle to meta-evaluation-tokens@hotmail.com.

Once paid, your access credentials will be activated within 10 minutes.

Sincerely,
Meta Talent Acquisition Division

subject: Supabase application status - Senior Database Engine Engineer
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for applying to Supabase. We truly appreciate your interest in our mission to build the open source Firebase alternative.

After reviewing your application, we have decided not to move forward for this specific role at this time. We received an extraordinary number of exceptional applications from around the world.

We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers page as we continue to grow rapidly and post new positions.

Cheers,
Paul & The Supabase Team

subject: OpenAI: Scheduling your Technical Presentation (Applied AI Platform)
body:
Hi Alex,

We're excited to invite you to the final interview stage for the Applied AI Platform role at OpenAI!

This session consists of a 45-minute presentation on a distributed system architecture you engineered, followed by Q&A with our research and systems engineers, plus a culture & safety alignment discussion.

Please reply with your timezone and preferred days next week so we can coordinate our panel.

Best,
Sarah Jenkins | Technical Recruiter, OpenAI

subject: Apple Cupertino Corporate Campus Offer - Mandatory Equipment Insurance Deposit
body:
Greetings Alex,

Apple Inc. is pleased to confirm your appointment as Lead iOS Architect at our Cupertino Apple Park headquarters. Package: $310,000 Total Compensation.

As part of standard Apple remote onboarding logistics, we require an upfront refundable hardware insurance policy deposit of $450 to cover your Apple Vision Pro developer kit and Apple Studio Display.

Please wire payment to Apple Authorized Vendor Account via Western Union or CashApp ($AppleVendorSecurity) by 5:00 PM today.

Regards,
Apple Talent Logistics Unit
